undergraduates and the
first course taken

students.

is to provide a field
experience for students indenting to enter
teacher-preparation, so they can deter-
mine whether their decision to enter
teaching

pose them to the range of challenges and
problems in the contemporary secondary
school. This school includes a pre-
practicum requirement.
